mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a pleasant temperature of 76 degrees at Harriet Park, with the first quarter moon phase visible tonight.
The City of Verona is working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes new water mains and sidewalks, alongside routine pavement rehabilitation for several local streets.
There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia fun at The Bogey Factory, with more music coming tomorrow at Concerts in the Park.
On Friday, Verona police handled a noteworthy call where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being found unresponsive in her vehicle.
You can enjoy the Double Strawberry flavor of the day at Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM this evening.
